'''Arla Ha'rangir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|shock trooper]] and a member of [[Clan Ha'rangir]]. She survived the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] but was later captured and brought before [[Clan Vizla]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
